objective: Assess the proposed scientific contract and recommend a rigorous, implementable, independently written subset of both supplied papers for a static browser topology explorer. Focus on correctness pitfalls, meaningful invariants and realistic first-generator algorithms; do not demand full original research implementation. The first generator must be honestly paper-based, include multiple valid quad patch templates/presets, closed cube/sphere connectivity, real soft guide influence, and derived network families. Give special attention to reconciling fixed cube creases, arbitrary guide directions, strip densities, and N-sided boundary subdivision counts. Do not copy unlicensed reference source. Return no more than 1800 words; recommend small executable tests and state exact unsupported guarantees. No tools or Git.
deliverable: Bounded method review, minimum useful supported subset, and adversarial verification cases
stop_condition: One independent review response; no tools, retries, implementation, or provider substitution
